 By

 Nov 20, 2026
 at

 •

 A pair of 5-5 teams in the Big 12 will meet on Friday's college football schedule as the Iowa State Cyclones visit the UCF Knights. Both programs are also 3-4 in conference play, with Iowa State coming off a Saturday win over Cincinnati, 41-13. However, the Cyclones have dropped their last three road games, all coming by double digits. Overall this season, their contests have averaged 54.4 points, while ISU's games have been even higher scoring in averaging 57.7 combined points. That number is trending upward for the Cyclones as their last three have averaged 75.7 total points.
 UCF is coming off a defeat to Arizona State, and the Over sports a 4-0 record in Knights games following a loss. Knights QB Alonzo Barnett is projected to have more passing yards, more passing touchdowns and fewer interceptions than his counterpart in ISU's Jaylen Raynor. However, the Cyclones offset that with RB Aiden Flora forecasted for nearly 140 yards on the ground.
